interactive_activities.title: Explore core social-science idea
interactive_activities.instructions: Complete an age-appropriate task focused specifically on core social-science idea. Record the evidence/work and explain what it shows.

interactive_activities.title: Apply the idea
interactive_activities.instructions: Create a new situation where evidence/source use is useful. Explain your reasoning and compare it with a second example.

interactive_activities.title: Teach it back
interactive_activities.instructions: Teach real-world application to a beginner in 3–5 clear steps, using an example or demonstration.

mastery_policy.on_failure: Route to weakest prerequisite/concept, reteach, practise and reassess.

spaced_retrieval.rule: Mix concepts; increase retrieval difficulty after successful reviews; remediate repeated failures.
